title: Shopping Cart Totals
description: Process m cart commands, one per line. ADD <cart> <qty> adds qty items to that cart only; TOTAL <cart> prints the cart's item count, or UNKNOWN when the cart does not exist. Each cart's count must live on its own instance, and the constructor must assign every field it declares. This is the transfer variant of 'Bank Account Ledger': same C7 skill (per-instance state plus correct construction), different domain and command vocabulary. Reusing the bank commands (OPEN/DEPOSIT/BALANCE) cannot process these carts.
input_format: First line: an integer m. Next m lines: commands ADD <cart> <qty> or TOTAL <cart>.
output_format: One line per TOTAL command: the item count, or UNKNOWN.
